teaser: You hand work to specialist subagents through the Agent tool and learn why only their final memo, never their notebook, comes back to you.
takeaways: Define subagents in agents={name: AgentDefinition(description, prompt, tools, model)} and include "Agent" in allowed_tools to delegate.
A subagent runs in an isolated context and cannot see the parent history, so the delegation prompt must carry all needed context.
Only the subagent's final message returns to the parent as the tool result; the parent merges summaries, not the subagent's full run.
Go multi-agent when tasks are separable, context would overflow, or specialization/parallelism pays; keep one agent for simple coupled work.
